title: Dominic and the Undertow
author: Silas Marchetti
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
